items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Sidney Boucher' in the context of a magazine article, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection, memory, or relationship to Sidney Boucher.

ctx.x: But you know Nick. Oh, very well. Played many, many times. I got a picture with Nick Ben-Oni playing in the same band. Red Nichols. Yeah, that's, that's...
Sidney Boucher. That's Look Magazine. And that's that same article. I'll give it a minute. Look. Jazz. That's that same article. Look. Jazz. 된된된
